title: Rep. Gilbert Cisneros Sold $1K-$15K of DoorDash (Disclosed Sep 10)
content:
Rep. Gilbert Cisneros (CA-31) disclosed a sale of $1,001–$15,000 of DoorDash (DASH) stock dated August 28, 2026.

Trade data: Bargo, compiled from U.S. House and Senate STOCK Act filings.

What's been disclosed

  • The sale: A sale of DoorDash stock worth $1,001–$15,000 on August 28, disclosed on September 10.
  • Price since: Bargo's estimate puts DoorDash about 20.1% lower on October 2 than the price on the sale date.
  • Filing: One trade line in the data we pulled for this member; no repeated rows.

Quick FAQ

How long after the sale was it disclosed?
13 days. The STOCK Act gives members 45 days from the transaction to disclose it.

Why are the amounts ranges?
Filings report value bands such as $1,001–$15,000 instead of exact dollar amounts.

Where does the price comparison come from?
It is Bargo's estimate, comparing the price on the transaction date with the October 2 price. It is not the member's actual execution price.
